# seerr_user_import_plex (Resource)

Import users from a connected Plex media server into Seerr via `/api/v1/user/import-from-plex`.

This resource facilitates the **bootstrap sequence**: Media Server Setup → `seerr_user_import_plex` → `seerr_permission_set` / `seerr_user_quota`.

If `plex_ids` is specified, only the matching Plex users are imported. If omitted or empty, all available Plex users on the server are imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Import all users from connected Plex media server during bootstrap
resource "seerr_user_import_plex" "all" {
  triggers = {
    version = "1.0"
  }
}

# Inspect imported users
output "plex_imported_count" {
  value = seerr_user_import_plex.all.imported_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `plex_ids` (Set of String) Optional set of specific Plex user IDs to import. If omitted, all available Plex users are imported.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary map of trigger values (e.g. `version = "1.0"`) to force a re-import action when values change.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier (defaults to `plex_import`).
- `imported_count` (Number) Number of users imported.
- `imported_users` (Attributes List) List of users imported from Plex. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--imported_users))

<a id="nestedatt--imported_users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `imported_users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The user's email address.
- `id` (String) The numeric Seerr user ID.
- `plex_id` (String) The user's Plex ID.
- `username` (String) The user's display name.
